customMethods.name: saveImport
customMethods.script:
if data is None: return
	
	result = {'passed': False, 'message': 'No check sheets were imported'}
	
	for record in data:
		system.perspective.print('record = %s'%record)
		chkSht = record['chkSht'] if 'chkSht' in record else None
		chkShtTypes = record['chkShtTypes'] if 'chkShtTypes' in record else []
		chkShtTriggers = record['chkShtTriggers'] if 'chkShtTriggers' in record else []
		chkItemGroups = record['chkItemGroups'] if 'chkItemGroups' in record else []
		chkItems = record['chkItems'] if 'chkItems' in record else []
		chkItemDataTypes = record['chkItemDataTypes'] if 'chkItemDataTypes' in record else []
		chkItemEngUnits = record['chkItemEngUnits'] if 'chkItemEngUnits' in record else []
		chkItemTypes = record['chkItemTypes'] if 'chkItemTypes' in record else []
		chkItemPickLists = record['chkItemPickLists'] if 'chkItemPickLists' in record else []
		assetLinks = record['assetLinks'] if 'assetLinks' in record else []
		itemLinks = record['itemLinks'] if 'itemLinks' in record else []
		itemSets = record['itemSets'] if 'itemSets' in record else []
		attributes = record['attributes'] if 'attributes' in record else []
		
		userId = int(self.view.custom.security.userId) if self.view.custom.security.userId is not None else None
		
		if userId is None: return
		
		result = self.importCheckSheet(chkSht, chkShtTypes, chkShtTriggers, chkItemGroups, chkItems, chkItemDataTypes, chkItemEngUnits, chkItemTypes, chkItemPickLists, assetLinks, itemLinks, itemSets, attributes, userId)
		
		self.view.refreshBinding("custom.table.data")
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast' if result['passed'] else 'showFailerToast', '\n - '.join([result['message']] + result['errorLog']))
	
	return

customMethods.name: importCheckSheet
customMethods.script:
log = system.util.getLogger('kanoa_quality')
	log.info('Calling importCheckSheet()')
	
	chkShtInfo = dict(chkSht)
	
	errorLog = []
	self.view.custom.info = {'showBar': True, 'text': 'Importing check sheets...', 'type': 'INFO'}
	
	# If the ckhShtType (folder) doesn't exist, create the ckhShtType.
	log.info('Checking sheet type')
	chkShtTypeId = None
	if chkShtInfo['chkShtTypeId'] is not None: 
		for chkShtType in chkShtTypes:
			chkShtTypeInfo = dict(chkShtType)
			chkShtType['parentId'] = chkShtType['parentId'] and chkShtTypeId
			
			chkShtTypeId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('chkShtTypeId', system.kanoa.quality.sheet.getSheetTypes({ 'path': chkShtTypeInfo['path'] }))
			if chkShtTypeId is None:
				log.info('adding sheet type')
				chkShtTypeId = system.kanoa.quality.sheet.addSheetType(chkShtTypeInfo, userId)
	
	if chkShtInfo['chkShtTypeId'] is not None: 
		for chkShtType in chkShtTypes:
			chkShtTypeInfo = dict(chkShtType)
			chkShtType['parentId'] = chkShtType['parentId'] and chkShtTypeId
			
			chkShtTypeId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('chkShtTypeId', system.kanoa.quality.sheet.getSheetTypes({ 'path': chkShtTypeInfo['path'] }))
			if chkShtTypeId is None:
				log.info('adding sheet type')
				chkShtTypeId = system.kanoa.quality.sheet.addSheetType(chkShtTypeInfo, userId)
	
	# Add the check sheet.
	log.info('adding check sheet')
	chkShtId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('chkShtId', system.kanoa.quality.sheet.getSheets({ 'path': chkSht['path'] }))
	if chkShtId is not None:
		chkShtInfo['chkShtName'] += ' ({})'.format(system.date.format(system.date.now(), 'YYYY.MM.dd HH.mm.ss'))
	
	chkShtInfo['chkShtId'] = None
	chkShtInfo['chkShtTypeId'] = chkShtTypeId
	chkShtInfo['reTestChkShtId'] = None # It may have a reference to a check sheet that hasn't been exported.
	log.info('adding check sheet')
	chkShtId, msg = system.kanoa.quality.sheet.addSheet(chkShtInfo, userId)
	
	if msg: return {'passed': False, 'message': msg, 'errorLog': errorLog}
	
	# If the assets linked to the chkSht do not exist in the gateway, don't create the asset and don't add the chkShtAsset link.
	log.info('checking asset links')
	assetIdList = [] 
	for assetLink in assetLinks:
		
		assetId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('assetId', system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({ 'assetPath': assetLink['assetPath'] }))
		
		if assetId is not None:
			assetIdList.append(assetId)
	
	if len(assetIdList) > 0: 
		log.info('adding asset links')
		system.kanoa.quality.sheet.addAssets(chkShtId, assetIdList, userId)
	
	# If the items linked to the checksheet do not exist in the gateway, don't create the items and don't add the chkShtItems link.
	log.info('checking item links')
	itemIdList = [] 
	for itemLink in itemLinks:
		itemId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('itemId', system.kanoa.item.getItems({ 'itemPath': itemLink['itemPath'] }))
		
		if itemId is not None:
			itemIdList.append(itemId)
	
	if len(itemIdList) > 0: 
		log.info('adding item links')
		system.kanoa.quality.sheet.addItems(chkShtId, itemIdList, userId)
	
	# If the itemSets linked to the checksheet do not exist in the gateway, but the items do exist, 
	# create the itemSets and link them in the chkShtItemsLink table. If the items don't exist, don't create the itemSet.
	log.info('checking item sets')
	for itemSet in itemSets:
		itemSetInfo = dict(itemSet)
		itemSetInfo['chkShtId'] = chkShtId
		
		itemSetId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('itemSetId', system.kanoa.quality.config.getItemSets({ 'itemSetName': itemSet['itemSetName'] }))
		
		if itemSetId is None:
			log.info('adding item set')
			itemSetId = system.kanoa.quality.config.addItemSet(itemSetInfo, userId)
		
		itemIdList = []
		
		for linkedItem in itemSet['links']:
			linkedItemInfo = dict(linkedItem)
			linkedItemInfo['itemSetId'] = itemSetId
			
			linkedItemId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('itemId', system.kanoa.item.getItems({'itemPath': linkedItemInfo['itemPath']}))
			if linkedItemId: 
				itemIdList.append(linkedItemId)
			else:
				errorLog.append('Unable to link item "%s" to item set "%s"'%(linkedItemInfo['itemPath'], itemSet['itemSetName']))
		
		if len(itemIdList):
			log.info('linking items to item sets')
			system.kanoa.quality.config.linkItems(itemSetId, itemIdList, True, userId)
	
	# Add the chkItemDataTypes
	log.info('checking data types')
	dataTypeIds = {}
	for dataType in chkItemDataTypes:
		dataTypeId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('dataTypeId', system.kanoa.quality.config.getDataTypes({ 'dataTypeName': dataType['dataTypeName'] }))
		if dataTypeId is None:
			log.info('adding data type')
			dataTypeId = system.kanoa.quality.config.addDataType(dataType, userId)
		dataTypeIds[dataType['dataTypeId']] = dataTypeId
	
	# Add the chkItemEngineeringUnits
	log.info('checking engineering units')
	engUnitIds = {}
	for engUnit in chkItemEngUnits:
		engUnitId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('engUnitId', system.kanoa.quality.config.getUnits({ 'engUnitName': engUnit['engUnitName'] }))
		if engUnitId is None:
			log.info('adding engineering unit')
			engUnitId = system.kanoa.quality.config.addUnit(engUnit, userId)
		engUnitIds[engUnit['engUnitId']] = engUnitId
	
	# Add the chkItemTypes
	log.info('checking item types')
	itemTypeIds = {}
	for itemType in chkItemTypes:
		itemTypeId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('chkItemTypeId', system.kanoa.quality.config.getCheckItemTypes({ 'chkItemTypeName': itemType['chkItemTypeName'] }))
		if itemTypeId is None:
			errorLog.append('No item type named %s'%itemType['chkItemTypeName'])
			continue
		itemTypeIds[itemType['chkItemTypeId']] = itemTypeId
	
	# Add the chkItemPickLists
	log.info('checking pick lists')
	pickListIds = {}
	for pickList in chkItemPickLists:
		pickListId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('pickListId', system.kanoa.quality.config.getPickList({ 'pickListName': pickList['pickListName'] }))
		if pickListId is None:
			errorLog.append('No pick list named %s'%pickList['pickListName'])
			continue
		pickListIds[pickList['pickListId']] = pickListId
	
	# If a chkItem has an attribute link, create attribute if it doesn't exist in the target system. 
	log.info('checking attributes')
	attrLinkIds = {}
	for attribute in attributes:
		if len(attribute['linkIds']) == 0: continue
		
		log.info('attr path = %s' % attribute['path'])
		attributeId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('attributeId', system.kanoa.quality.config.getAttributes({ 'path': attribute['path'] }))
		
		if attributeId is None:
			log.info('adding attribute')
			parentPath = '\\'.join(attribute['path'].split('\\')[:-1]) or None
			attribute['parentId'] = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('attributeId', system.kanoa.quality.config.getAttributes({ 'path': parentPath})) if parentPath else None
			
			log.info('adding attribute for %s with parentId %s'%(attribute['attributeName'], attribute['parentId']))
			
			attributeId = system.kanoa.quality.config.addAttribute(attribute, userId)
		
		if attributeId is None:
			errorLog.append('Could not create attribute %s'%attribute['path'])
			continue
		
		for linkId in attribute['linkIds']:
			log.info('oldAttrId: %s, newAttrId: %s'%(linkId, attributeId))
			attrLinkIds[linkId] = attributeId
		
		# If the attribute has a datasource, create attributeDataSource.
		for dataSource in attribute['dataSource']:
			dataSourceInfo = dict(dataSource)
			dataSourceInfo['attributeId'] = attributeId 
			
			log.info('adding dataSource')
			attributeDataSourceId = system.kanoa.quality.config.addDataSource(dataSourceInfo, userId)
	
		# If assetId and itemId exist, add attributeTolerances.
		for tolerance in attribute['tolerances']:
			assetId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('assetId', system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({ 'assetPath': tolerance['assetPath'] }))
			if assetId is None: continue
			
			itemId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('itemId', system.kanoa.item.getItems({ 'itemPath': tolerance['itemPath'] }))
			if itemId is None: continue
			
			toleranceInfo = dict(tolerance)
			toleranceInfo['attributeId'] = attributeId
			toleranceInfo['assetId'] = assetId
			toleranceInfo['itemId'] = itemId
			toleranceInfo['itemClassId'] = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('itemClassId', system.kanoa.item.getItemClasses({ 'itemClassPath': tolerance['itemClassPath'] }))
			toleranceInfo['itemSetId'] = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('itemSetId', system.kanoa.quality.config.getItemSets({ 'itemSetName': tolerance['itemSetName'] }))
			
			log.info('adding tolerance')
			attributeToleranceId = system.kanoa.quality.config.addTolerance(toleranceInfo, userId)
	
	# Add the chkItemGroups
	log.info('checking item groups %s'%chkItemGroups)
	chkItemIds = {}
	
	for chkItemGroup in chkItemGroups:
		chkItemGroupInfo = dict(chkItemGroup)
		chkItemGroupInfo['chkShtId'] = chkShtId
		
		log.info('adding item group')
		chkItemGroupId = system.kanoa.quality.config.addGroup(chkItemGroupInfo, userId)
	
		# Add chkItems under the chkItemGroup
		breakout = None
		for chkItem in chkItems:
			if chkItem['chkItemTriggerId']:
				if not chkItem['chkItemTriggerId'] in chkItemIds:
					if chkItem['chkItemId'] == breakout:
						# This condition should never be reached. If it does, then the file was probably exported wrong.
						errorLog.append('The trigger id for %s could not be found.'% chkItem['chkItemName'])
						break
					if breakout is None: breakout = chkItem['chkItemId']
					continue
				else:
					breakout = None
			
			if chkItem['chkItemGroupId'] != chkItemGroup['chkItemGroupId']: continue
			
			if not chkItem['chkItemTypeId'] in itemTypeIds: 
				errorLog.append('Unable to add check item "%s" due to missing item type'%(chkItem['chkItemName']))
				continue
			
			if chkItem['pickListId'] and not chkItem['pickListId'] in pickListIds: 
				errorLog.append('Unable to add check item "%s" due to missing pick list'%(chkItem['chkItemName']))
				continue
			
			chkItemIds[chkItem['chkShtId']] = chkShtId
			chkItemInfo = dict(chkItem)
			chkItemInfo['chkShtId'] = chkShtId
			
			chkItemInfo['chkItemGroupId'] = chkItemGroupId
			if chkItem['dataTypeId']: chkItemInfo['dataTypeId'] = dataTypeIds[chkItem['dataTypeId']]
			if chkItem['engUnitId']: chkItemInfo['engUnitId'] = engUnitIds[chkItem['engUnitId']]
			if chkItem['chkItemTypeId']: chkItemInfo['chkItemTypeId'] = itemTypeIds[chkItem['chkItemTypeId']]
			if chkItem['pickListId']: chkItemInfo['pickListId'] = pickListIds[chkItem['pickListId']]
			if chkItem['chkItemAttrLinkId']: chkItemInfo['chkItemAttrLinkId'] = attrLinkIds[chkItem['chkItemAttrLinkId']]
			if chkItem['chkItemTriggerId']: chkItemInfo['chkItemTriggerId'] = chkItemIds[chkItem['chkItemTriggerId']]
			
			if chkItem['calculation']:
				startingIndex = chkItem['calculation'].find("'values':")
				endingIndex = chkItem['calculation'].find(",'script'")
				chkItemInfo['calculation'] = chkItem['calculation'].replace(chkItem['calculation'][startingIndex + 9:endingIndex], '"%s"'%chkItem['calculation'][startingIndex + 10:endingIndex - 1])
			
			log.info('adding check')
			chkItemId = system.kanoa.quality.config.addCheck(chkItemInfo, userId)
	
	# Add chkShtTriggers
	log.info('checking sheet triggers')
	for trigger in chkShtTriggers:
		triggerInfo = dict(trigger)
		triggerTypeId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('triggerTypeId', system.kanoa.quality.config.getTriggerTypes({'triggerTypeName': trigger['triggerTypeName']}))
		
		if triggerTypeId is None:
			errorLog.append('Unable to add check sheet trigger "%s" due to missing trigger type'%(trigger['triggerTypeName']))
			continue
		
		triggerInfo['chkShtId'] = chkShtId
		triggerInfo['triggerTypeId'] = triggerTypeId
		
		log.info('adding trigger')
		system.kanoa.quality.config.addChkShtTrigger(triggerInfo, userId)
	
	self.view.custom.info = {'showBar': False, 'text': '', 'type': 'INFO'}
	
	return {'passed': True, 'message': 'The check sheet was imported.', 'errorLog': errorLog}

transforms.code:
data = value['data']
	if len(data) == 0: return []
	
	self.view.custom.info = {"showBar": True, "text": "Formatting check sheets", "type": "INFO"}	
	
	stateColors = list(set([row["chkShtVersionStateColor"] for row in data]))
	foreColors = {}
	for stateColor in stateColors:
		foreColors[stateColor] = system.kanoa.utilities.getContrastingColor(stateColor)	
		
	rows = []
	for row in data:
		row = dict(row)
		
		options = self.view.custom.chkShtVersionStates
		if row['chkShtVersionStateName'] == 'Draft': excludeStates = ['In Revision', 'Archived']
		elif row['chkShtVersionStateName'] == 'Released': excludeStates = ['Draft', 'Archived']
		elif row['chkShtVersionStateName'] == 'In Revision': excludeStates = ['Draft', 'Archived']
		elif row['chkShtVersionStateName'] == 'Archived': excludeStates = ['Draft']
		elif row['chkShtVersionStateName'] is None: excludeStates = ['In Revision', 'Archived']
		else: excludeStates = []
		
		rowOptions = [d for d in options if d.get("label") not in excludeStates]
		
		row['chkShtVersionStateId'] = {
							'value': row['chkShtVersionStateId'], 
							'options': rowOptions,
							'editable': self.view.custom.userAction.canCreate,
							'msgHandler': 'chkShtVersionStateSelected',
							'chkShtId': row['chkShtId'],
							'masterChkShtId': row['masterChkShtId']
						}
		
		row['lastUpdated'] = "%s by %s"%(system.date.format(row['changedDate'] or row['createdDate'], 'YY-MM-dd HH:mm'), row['changedByUser'] or row['createdByUser'])
		
		rows.append(row)

	self.view.custom.info = {"showBar": False, "text": "", "type": "INFO"}
	
	return rows

	userAction = self.view.custom.userAction

	return

deleteChkSht
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print('deleteChkSht() called')	
	
	selectedData = payload['inputPayload']['selectedData']
	for item in selectedData:
		retVal, msg = system.kanoa.quality.sheet.deleteSheet(item['chkShtId'], self.view.custom.security.userId)
		if msg is None: system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': '%s has been deleted'%item['chkShtName']})
		else: 
			system.perspective.print(msg)
			system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': msg})	
			msg = 'Check Sheet has historical data associated with it. Deleting %s will also delete the historical data. Do you wish to continue?'%item['chkShtName']
			system.perspective.openPopup('userDeleteConfirm', 'kanoa/core/templates/inputs/confirm', {'text':msg, 'messageHandler':'deleteChkShtHistory', 'inputPayload': {'selectedData': selectedData}}, title='Delete Check Sheet and Historical data', modal=True, overlayDismiss=True)
			return

	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.table.data")
	
	return

customMethods.name: closeEditor
customMethods.script:
self.getChild("evEditor").props.params = {'chkShtId': None, 'editMode':False}
	
	self.view.custom.table.showTable = True
	self.view.custom.table.selection.col = None	
	self.view.custom.table.selection.row = None
	
	return

messageHandlers.script:
system.perspective.print("editorAction msg rcvd with payload %s"%(payload))	

	action = payload.get('action')
	if action in ('SAVED', 'CANCELED', 'CLOSED'):
		self.closeEditor()
		self.view.refreshBinding("custom.table.data")
		
	return

system.perspective.print("chkShtTypeFilterSelected msg rcvd with payload %s"%(payload))	
	
	self.view.custom.filter.chkShtPath = payload['selection'][0]['value']['path'] if len(payload['selection']) > 0 else None
	
	return

'''
		Valid state changes
		 -  None to 'Draft':	Set ver # to 1
		 - 'Draft' to 'Released': Do nothing
		 - 'Released' to 'Draft': Do nothing
		 - 'Released' to 'In Revision': Duplicate checksheet. Increment ver #
		 - 'In Revision' to 'Released': Archive current released master, update existing checksheet to values from duplicate checksheet, delete duplcate checksheet, increment ver #
		 - 'Archived' to 'Released': Archive current released master, update existing checksheet to values from archived checksheet, increment ver #
		Updated:
			jfc 08/20/25 10:29am: Created
	'''

	system.perspective.print("chkShtVersionStateSelected msg rcvd with payload %s"%(payload))
	
	if not self.view.custom.userAction.canUpdate:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': 'User does not have permissions to update this check sheet.'})
		self.view.refreshBinding("custom.table.data")
		return
		
	self.view.custom.info = {"showBar": True, "text": "Updating status ", "type": "INFO"}	
	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId

	masterChkShtId = int(payload['params']['masterChkShtId'])
	chkShtId = int(payload['params']['chkShtId'])
	chkShtVersionStateId = int(payload['value'])
	chkShtVersionStates = {item["value"]: item["label"] for item in self.view.custom.chkShtVersionStates}
	chkShtVersionStateName = chkShtVersionStates[chkShtVersionStateId] if chkShtVersionStates.has_key(chkShtVersionStateId) else None	
	
	retVal, msg = system.kanoa.quality.sheet.updateSheetVersionState(masterChkShtId, chkShtId, chkShtVersionStateName, userId)

	if msg: system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': 'Check Sheet status could not be updated. %s'%msg})
	else: system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Check Sheet status has been updated'})
	
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.table.data")
	self.view.custom.info = {"showBar": False, "text": "", "type": "INFO"}
	
	return

system.perspective.print("openEditor msg rcvd with payload %s"%(payload))
	
	self.openEditor(payload['chkShtId'])
	
	return
